description: This file defines the PPS class used for creating and managing Property Storage Structures (PPS) within OLE containers, including methods for serialization and managing hierarchical relationships.

classes.name: PPS
classes.description: Represents a Property Storage Structure (PPS) in an OLE container, with properties for hierarchy, timestamps, data, and methods for serialization and hierarchy management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a PPS object with specified properties such as index, name, type, hierarchy links, timestamps, data, and children.

methods.name: getDataLen
methods.description: Returns the size of the data stored in the PPS.

methods.name: getPpsWk
methods.description: Generates a binary string representing the PPS's WK structure, including metadata and timestamps.

methods.name: savePpsSetPnt
methods.description: Recursively assigns hierarchy pointers and indexes to a list of PPS objects for serialization.
